name: wavetable morph plus filter motion patch
goal: Create an evolving hybrid patch using a wavetable oscillator (Osc3 role), optional duo-stack/detune/stereo spread, and animated WT position + filter cutoff.

source.title: TRAVELER: The Cinematic Hybrid Synthesizer | Official Walkthrough

prerequisites: Hybrid synth or Traveler-inspired Web Audio engine with multi-osc, stereo filter, envelopes, LFOs/mod matrix, sequenced control tracks (or automation), and FX (EQ/chorus/delay/reverb)

inputs.name: wavetable_source
inputs.description: Original or freely licensed WT — never rip Traveler banks

inputs.name: morph_mod
inputs.description: LFO, envelope, or control-track driving WT position

outputs.name: wt_motion_patch
outputs.description: Wavetable morph + filter motion cinematic patch

constraints: Original synthesis only; not affiliated with KeySolutions; do not rip Traveler samples/presets/wavetables.
Original synthesis only — design new patches from portable parameters; do not copy proprietary Traveler factory preset names, banks, wavetables, or samples.
Not affiliated with KeySolutions Sounds or Traveler; concepts mapped to generic hybrid-synth / Web Audio equivalents.
Do not rip, dump, or redistribute Traveler content.
Prefer recreating the described signal-flow and motion relationships in our browser music system or any hybrid synth with comparable modules.

steps.action: Osc3 role: switch from analog waveforms to wavetable mode. Load an original/freely available WT (do not import Traveler proprietary tables).
Optional: enable 2-voice stack, detune, and stereo spread on the WT osc for width.
Optional drone mode: disconnect Osc3 from keyboard for a fixed-pitch layer, or use it as an extra LFO-rate modulator.
steps.expect: Drone or extra mod source if chosen

steps.action: Modulate wavetable position from LFO or Control Track; keep depth subtle for evolving texture rather than obvious sweeps unless desired.
Stereo filter: ladder model (6–24 dB) or NJM-style; add HP that can link to primary cutoff for band-pass motion. Modulate cutoff from filter envelope and/or LFO.
Mixer: balance WT vs analog oscs; add noise (white/pink) sparingly; light drive into filter.
steps.expect: Hybrid blend, not one osc dominating unless intentional

verification: WT position clearly moves under modulation
Filter and WT motion are musically related
